CNG prices rose in several locations, with increases of up to ₹ 2 in Chennai, Mathura and Meerut. Sounak Mukhopadhyay Published 28 Oct 2026, 06:52 AM IST Prefer Livemint on Google Petrol and diesel prices today, October 28: Check fuel rates in different cities across India (Sunil Ghosh/HT PHOTO) ( Sunil Ghosh/HT PHOTO ) AI Quick Read Petrol and diesel prices remain unchanged across major Indian cities today. However, CNG prices have increased in several places, including Mumbai, Chennai and Bengaluru. Fuel rates continue to differ widely between cities. New Delhi records petrol at ₹ 102.12 and diesel at ₹ 95.20. Mumbai has petrol at ₹ 111.21 while diesel stands at ₹ 97.83. In Kolkata, petrol costs ₹ 113.51 while diesel costs ₹ 99.82. Chennai records petrol at ₹ 107.76 and diesel at ₹ 99.55. Hyderabad has the highest petrol price among major cities, at ₹ 116.15. Thiruvananthapuram follows at ₹ 115.49 while Kolkata stands at ₹ 113.51. Patna records ₹ 113.37, and Jaipur has petrol priced at ₹ 113.19. Bangalore's petrol price stands at ₹ 111.68, above Mumbai's ₹ 111.21. Also Read | Land Rover Defender 110 price drops by ₹34 lakh after local assembly in India Chandigarh has the lowest petrol price among these cities, at ₹ 101.54. Lucknow follows at ₹ 101.86 while Noida records ₹ 101.96. Gurgaon has petrol at ₹ 102.97, and Bhubaneswar records ₹ 108.97. Every listed petrol price remains above ₹ 100. Diesel prices present a different order at the higher end. Thiruvananthapuram records the highest listed diesel rate, at ₹ 104.40. Hyderabad follows closely at ₹ 104.23, with Bhubaneswar at ₹ 100.68. These three cities have diesel prices above ₹ 100. Chandigarh records the lowest diesel price , at ₹ 89.47. New Delhi follows at ₹ 95.20, with Lucknow at ₹ 95.36. Noida records ₹ 95.44 while Gurgaon stands at ₹ 95.64. Jaipur has diesel at ₹ 98.25, and Patna records ₹ 99.36. Bangalore's diesel price is ₹ 99.56, slightly above Chennai's ₹ 99.55. Also Read | Rubio to visit Reliance Industries’ Jamnagar facilities - What is on the agenda The petrol price gap between Hyderabad and Chandigarh stands at ₹ 14.61. For diesel, Thiruvananthapuram exceeds Chandigarh by ₹ 14.93. Kolkata's petrol costs ₹ 2.30 more than Mumbai's rate. However, its diesel costs ₹ 1.99 more than Mumbai's price. Among nearby cities, Gurgaon records higher petrol and diesel prices than New Delhi. Noida's petrol costs less than New Delhi's although its diesel price is higher. CNG prices today CNG prices have risen by ₹ 2 in Chennai, Mathura and Meerut. Chennai's CNG rate now stands at ₹ 99.50. Mathura records ₹ 102 while Meerut has CNG priced at ₹ 95.50. These are the largest increases among the listed CNG locations. Also Read | Delhi CNG Prices Rise 4 Times In 12 Days | Petrol, Diesel At Highest Since 2022 Mumbai and Bengaluru have recorded CNG increases of ₹ 1 each. Their prices stand at ₹ 89 and ₹ 98, respectively. Sonipat also records a ₹ 1 increase, taking its rate to ₹ 95. Bharatpur and Dewas each record increases of 50 paise, reaching ₹ 98. Firozabad's CNG price rises by 50 paise to ₹ 99.50. CNG rates remain unchanged in New Delhi, Hyderabad, Rewari and NCR. New Delhi and NCR both record ₹ 86.98. Rewari stands at ₹ 91.59 while Hyderabad records ₹ 112. Hyderabad has the highest CNG rate among the listed locations. New Delhi and NCR share the lowest listed CNG price.
